messages:
kevin: quick follow-up on the host-page coordination RFC — thinking about timelines for residency contract enforcement. TL;DR: we need a grace window before hard eviction to avoid tail-latency spikes. RFC: https://go/repo/rfcs/hostpage-residency

maria: agree. what window are you thinking? our immediate-evict experiment showed a ~200ms tail spike for small requests (p99 up).

kevin: heads-up on numbers: 1s grace reduces p99 by ~120ms but increases VRAM steady by ~4%. 5s gives much smoother tails but ups VRAM by ~10% and increases host-staging churn.

jasper: can we make it tenant-configurable (opt-in)? e.g. residency_contract = {grace_ms: 1000, eviction_policy: "prefetch"} so latency-sensitive tenants can favor grace.

sara: tenant-config makes sense functionally but adds scheduling complexity. we need system-level hard limits so a single tenant can't starve others.

kevin: plan idea: soft_contract per-tenant + global hard_limit. soft contract issues priority tokens; eviction and offload heuristics prefer yielding tenants with fewer tokens. hard_limit still triggers immediate reclamation.

maria: how do tokens work across async offload? if offload moves pages to host, fragmentation on host could block future staging. need to account for host fragmentation in the token model.

jasper: rough API sketch — please bikeshed:

```
// acquire a soft lease for N pages
lease = TokenAllocator.acquire(tenant="acct-42", pages=256, grace_ms=1000)
// return a lease when done
TokenAllocator.release(lease)
// eviction consults leases: prefer pages without active leases
```
This gives the runtime a lease_id hint rather than tying it to a particular address.

sara: +1 to lease id approach. must include TTL and revocation. also: add a global admission controller that enforces max tokens per-node.

kevin: telemetry requirements: hotset estimator feeding TokenAllocator (LRU sample, KV-cache hits, seq-length windows). cheap estimator: sample 1% of requests and extrapolate.

maria: for rollout I'd like: (1) dedicated infra opt-in, (2) canary which only logs (soft-only), (3) small forced canary with soft enforcement and kill-switch. collect fragmentation metrics (largest_free_chunk, total_free, avg-residency) + p99 tail.

jasper: tests: unit for TokenAllocator, sim harness for tenant mixes, e2e on staging with heavy offload pattern. add synthetic fragmentation test (scatter allocations + offload).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary/hostpage-residency-v2 -> staging at 1718675355 :rocket:

maria: note for the RFC update: include concrete numbers for 1s vs 5s grace, and include fragmentation traces showing host-side compaction failures. we saw worst-fit failing 3x more often after aggressive offload in the lab.

sara: also include a safety rollback plan (kill-switch + global eviction override). ops should be able to flip to immediate hard_limit eviction per-cluster.

kevin: action items: jasper - draft API + unit tests; maria - perf runs on 8xA100 and fragmentation traces; sara - design global cap + rollback knobs; i'll update the RFC with numbers and a deployment playbook. ping me if you want to pair this afternoon. :thumbsup:

maria: i'll start the perf matrix now and share a short notebook with plots.

jasper: will push a prototype TokenAllocator sketch by EOD.

sara: adding ops runbook stub to the RFC branch.

kevin: thanks all — small follow-up meeting later if needed.
